EXPLANATORY NOTE

 

On May 1, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the appointment of Jerry Lydon as Head of North America Commercial Operations. The Company also provided an update on progress under its Comprehensive Transformation Plan and reported selected financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2025. A copy of the press release is filed herewith as Exhibit 99.1.
